method: Manual whole-file reading of877lines; bytes matched pinned Git object. No script execution.
findings: PGO script automates instrumented workload execution and pgomgr merges, not instrumentation/optimized builds or independent performance comparison. Catalog has19workloads:13scan variants,3duplicate scans and3load sessions.

Scan variants exercise fast/basic engines,CSV/JSON,glob/regex,age/size,hidden/protected,thread1/8,hardlink/privilege toggles and reparse following. Duplicate variants use xxHash,SHA512,MD5. No authored equality oracle or expected output assertions.

Nonzero scan exit logs warning and still invokes profile merge. Per-scenario exceptions are caught and loop continues; no aggregate failure exit is emitted. Missing seed PGD or missing PGC produces warnings. Completion message is not a regression pass.

Load sessions sleep configured12seconds then request close or force kill, without observing load completion or comparing reexported results. Force-kill paths do not consistently wait for process exit before accessing ExitCode/profile files; actual failure behavior untested.

PGC attribution compares new filenames only, not changed content of existing names. Merge consumes all matching basename PGCs, including preexisting ones, then moves them under scenario label; profile provenance is not strictly per-scenario.

Portable WinDirStat.ini is rewritten beside executable and removed at end, without backup/restore of an existing file. Exception recovery enumerates processes by executable basename rather than tracked process handle. These are source-observed reasons to use isolated owned binaries if this script is ever executed.
List option resolves executable context and creates work/artifact directories before listing; it is not filesystem-side-effect-free. No listing or other script execution was performed here.

Regex include anchor only escapes backslashes, not all regex metacharacters in a user-supplied RestrictiveIncludeRoot. Default path does not demonstrate the problem; custom paths containing regex punctuation require a separate control.
limits: No Windows PGO toolchain, original workload, timing or memory behavior executed.
All17tracked test-directory files now have whole-file reading credit, including launcher, scenario definitions, harness and analysis/training scripts. This does not imply tests passed.
No production code adopted. Native pHash investigation remains deferred.
